children.value: > Fact From Story: The belief that Meta shadowbans, or limits the visibility of, content about Palestine is not new.
> > Fact From Story: As soon as Kehlani got super vocal and changed her profile picture to “i stand with Palestine” she got shadowbanned.
> > > > Fact From Story: Bella Hadid alleged that Instagram “disabled” her from posting content on her Story “pretty much only when it is Palestine based.”
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: If something has happened to multiple people, it is not new.

> > Fact From Story: In an Instagram Story last year, supermodel and activist Bella Hadid, who is of Palestinian descent, alleged that Instagram “disabled” her from posting content on her Story “pretty much only when it is Palestine based.”
> > > Fact From Story: Meta blamed technical errors for the removal of posts about Palestine during the 2021 conflict.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Blaming technical errors is a way to limit the visibility of content.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If something has happened before, it is not new.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Shadowbanning is a form of censorship.
